scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.//build: Git-connected Netlify build: build the SPA + assemble static. Netlify bundles netlify/functions itself.
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run assemble
scripts.//package: Drag-and-drop build: clean, build SPA, bundle functions self-contained, assemble a no-build publish/ folder to drop on Netlify.
scripts.package: node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build:admin && npm run bundle:functions && npm run assemble
